items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I appeared in the film as, you know, a saxophone soloist. I did some writing; I don't remember the extent of it now, but it was just some, you know, arranging. That was ... let's see, was that Hugo Friedhofer or was it Bernie Herman's picture.

ctx.x: And Herman had done it as a composer and Stanley Wilson was the music head, and after we finished doing this, and I had met Stanley. he asked me if I'd be interested in doing composition on 'M Squad,' you know ... doing a segment.
